Reel Monster
Lets Reel Monster count reels automatically. It only listens for scrolling in Instagram and YouTube, never reads screen text, and sends nothing anywhere.

How to use: tap “Start the monster bubble”, allow “Display over other apps”, then open Instagram or YouTube. Level 1: tap the monster once after each reel you watch. Level 2: turn on Reel Monster in Accessibility settings and the monster counts each reel itself. Drag the monster to move it. Long-press it to open this app.
Monster bubble: ready — tap Start to show it.
